profile.headline: I am a software engineer who is passionate and curious. I love learning all I can to solve difficult problems.
profile.summary: I am a curious and passionate Software Engineer. I pick up new skills and become a productive team member quickly to make an impact. I collaborate with team members to combine our shared knowledge and work together toward our common goal. I enjoy UI design and thinking through user experience to make intuitive products. I take an active role to improve team processes, helping people on my team feel prepared, plan long-term, and stay organized. I can break down technical subjects and put them in broadly understandable terms and strive to create clarity in group discussions.

positions.title: Lead, Software Engineering
positions.description:
Chief Software Engineer leading a team of 15 software engineers. Oversaw design, development, test, release, and support of 7 software applications on an annual cadence, including an upgrade to RHEL 8. Software was in Java and JavaScript.
Group Lead meeting with 5-6 software engineers biweekly to connect on performance, career, and goals. Collected feedback from programs and conducted yearly performance reviews.
Contributed to proposals and studies for new work proposed by the government.
Worked with cross-functional program leadership to align work being done to customer priorities. Actively collaborated with the customer to identify needs and prioritize work for the software that would support the user.
Implemented Agile and software best practices and guided the team through the transition.
Updated Java application to address edge cases and produce reliable communication with several models of equipment.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Red Hat Enterprise Linux (RHEL) · Technical Leadership

positions.title: Software Engineer II
positions.description:
Working on API services that support supervisors in call centers. This includes creating test plans, designing and documenting the plan, developing the code, and testing the end-to-end workflow.
Worked on a React front-end application used by customer support advocates.
Mentoring interns and early in career developers to help them contribute to the team.
Created API micro-services with Azure Function Apps and Azure API Management.
Participated in interviewing for Intern, University Hire, and Full Time Employee positions.
Organized and ran fundraisers during Microsoft's October Giving campaign to raise money for non-profit organizations and get team members involved in giving.

positions.title: Senior Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
Promoted to Software Engineer II one year after being hired.
Worked with a commercial off-the-shelf product to command and control hardware.
Saved the customer 3.1 million in 5 months by developing an in-house solution to replace the previously used product.
Self-taught Java and SNMP communication to develop the in-house solution.
Worked with a team member to create seamless communication between the hardware control portion of the code and the existing backend.
Assisted in recruiting activities at the University of Colorado, Boulder, which resulted in two new hires.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant in Data Systems
positions.description:
Developed a new Python plotting program to transition LASP scientists from the old and unsupported IDL program, Tplot.
Got feedback from scientists who used Tplot to determine the requirements and stretch goals of the program.
Worked mostly independently and utilized the Bokeh Python interactive visualization library to allow users to load and plot time-series data in an easy to observe format that allows the user to interact with the plotted data.
Backwards compatible with command style of the IDL Tplot program.
Completed the first version of the program in 2 months, when the expected time of completion was 12 months. With the remaining time in my internship, I completed stretch goals for the program.

company.name: Laboratory For Atmospheric and Space Physics

honors.title: U Xcel
honors.description: Rachel joined the Infrastructure Software team and quickly became the expert on CodeMettle translators used on the system. She developed the Infrastructure Software Extension to fulfill failed requirements CodeMettle could not meet, replace CodeMettle as the equipment command and control solution, and ultimately save the customer $3.1M over the lifetime of the Signal Processing System.

volunteerExperiences.description:
Volunteering in a middle school and mentoring kids outside of school (6 hours a week).
Organizing and running events for around 20 kids biweekly.
Go to the school two days a week and help in a teacher's classroom. Kids from 7th and 8th grade come in before school to get help in their classes and coursework.

projects.title: Food For Thought Volunteer App
projects.description:
The non-profit Food for Thought needed an application to organize their volunteers and administration.
I worked with my team in the development of the application using Ionic Framework, AngularJS, HTML, and CSS.
Food for Thought was given an application front end that made it simple for volunteers to sign up to volunteer. Administrators were able to organize and keep track of volunteer information, as well as create volunteer shifts within the application.

projects.title: Python Mastermind Game
projects.description:
Used Agile methods to develop a version of the mastermind computer game from scratch with a team of four.
Learned and used the Python graphics library and wrote code to implement the playable aspects of the game. I lead the tracking of the project; which included the creation and assigning of tasks and tracking of the tasks using Trello.

organizations.name: Alpha Delta Chi
organizations.description: Sorority at the University of Colorado at Boulder. Elected by peers to handle large sums of money and keep accurate financial records for the sorority. Took care of updating sorority website using Dotster and managing email lists.
